subject: NimbleHealth infra deep-dive — scheduling & agenda
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: NimbleHealth infra deep-dive — scheduling & agenda

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap: NimbleHealth is optimizing model latency for real-time triage, you have privacy constraints on PII-heavy examples, and you want an ops-ready plan that balances latency vs cost for a 3rd-party model + caching approach.

Next step we discussed: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML infra and platform engineers to:
- walk your current inference flow and constraints (10–15 min)
- review candidate serving architectures and trade-offs (25–35 min)
- run through a light perf/cost projection for your workload (15–20 min)
- define owners, data requirements, and success criteria (10–15 min)

Proposed slots (all PT):
1) Tue 16 Sep, 10:00–11:30
2) Wed 17 Sep, 13:00–14:30
3) Thu 18 Sep, 08:30–10:00

Please let me know which slot works best and who from your side will attend (ML lead + infra/ops preferred). I’m copying Karthik (ML/infra lead), Grace (Platform reliability) and Ben (your SE) so they can confirm availability.

Attached: brief discovery recap and a short pre-read that lists what we’ll ask for during the session (sample traces, token distributions, retention constraints). HubSpot record linked below so we can attach notes and the eventual mutual action plan.

Thanks — happy to tighten the agenda if you want different priorities.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Morgan <alex@nimblehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@nimblehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Sep 2025 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NimbleHealth infra deep-dive — scheduling & agenda

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear recap. Wed 17 Sep 13:00–14:30 PT looks good for our team (Samir and I). One ask: could we nudge the start 30 minutes earlier to 12:30 PT? We have a standing partner check at 14:30. If not, 13:00 still works.

Attendees from our side: Alex Morgan (Director, ML), Samir Patel (Lead Data Engineer). We’ll aim to have a few representative traces and a short overview doc ready.

Thanks — please confirm and we’ll lock the calendar.

All —

Thanks for the heads-up, Alex. I can take the session on Wed 17 Sep but I have a 12:30 PT conflict. If we can do 12:00–13:30 PT that would be ideal for me (I can free 12:00–13:30). Otherwise I can attend 13:00–14:30 and step out for 20 minutes at 13:40 — not ideal for the perf/cost discussion.

Quick notes for agenda — things I want to cover if possible:
- expected concurrency and median vs p95 latency targets (please include sample traces)
- token length distribution and batching sensitivity (we’ll prepare quick sim)
- acceptable data retention windows and KMS/HSM needs (we may need SOC2 artifacts)
- fallback model variant & routing policy for regional latency SLOs

Hannah — I attached the short pre-ask checklist (redwood-tdx-pre-read.md). Alex, could you confirm whether sample traces can be anonymized or if we need to set up an encrypted transfer? If SOC2 evidence is required in advance, flag and we’ll coordinate through security.

—
Karthik
ML Infrastructure Lead | Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks, and great question about the start time. We’ll lock Wed 17 Sep 12:00–13:30 PT to accommodate Karthik and give a small buffer for follow-ups. I’ll send the calendar invite and include an agenda with timeboxes.

Final attendee roster we’ll include on the invite:
- Alex Morgan (NimbleHealth) — Director, ML
- Samir Patel (NimbleHealth) — Lead Data Engineer
- Hannah Schmitt (Redwood) — Solutions Architect (host)
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — ML Infrastructure Lead
- Grace O'Connor (Redwood) — Platform Reliability
- Ben Carter (Redwood) — Solutions Engineer (SE)

Action items before the session:
- Alex/Samir: upload anonymized sample traces or advise on encrypted transfer by Tue 16 Sep EOD (see pre-read list).
- Redwood: send calendar invite with Zoom, agenda, and a short perf-cost template we’ll fill during the call.
- If Nimble needs SOC2 artifacts ahead of time, Alex please confirm and we’ll route through Security.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765 — Ben, please attach the discovery notes.

Thanks — invite coming shortly.

Best,
